questions.a: HIGHER-ORDER BUILD-THE-TEST-FIRST (Akien's coinage for the move): not unit tests of the module's code (the proof does that) but the EXTERNAL acceptance gate for the module's output, installed before the module — the judge in another component, behind another write-gate.

TEST-FIRST AND LEARNS-FROM-FAILURE ARE COMPATIBLE HERE, NOT IN GENERAL: these filters install only because their seeding failures were measured before the module existed. A filter for a module with no failure lineage would be a speculative contract — that stays red.
